verdict.rationale: Loops' API page says to 'use the OpenAPI spec for toolchains, validation, and client generation.' A hands-on probe confirmed https://loops.so/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 and contains an 'openapi' key, so the spec is publicly downloadable. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the spec itself (its version, how much of the API it covers, and how often it is updated); the docs give only a one-line mention.
